Class ToolsThinking

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.ToolsThinking
public final class ToolsThinking extends Object
The ToolsThinking type places Show Thinking, the item under the Tools menu, on the main menu. The main menu is the bar of menu names across the window. The type reveals the thinking pane of the plate in front, the visible product tab. The closed pane starts its rise at slide 0. The fold opens. The hidden text is shown again. The pane that is already open keeps the slide it has. The other plate keeps the same ToolsThinking.Seat. The log stays as it is, because this type does not write the log. The closed mark on the file stays as it is, because this type does not write that mark. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#ToolsThinking

  • Method Details

    • front

      public static ToolsThinking.Plate front(int tab)
      The front method names the product tab that is in front. The method returns ToolsThinking.Plate.AETHERIS when the tab index is 1. The method returns ToolsThinking.Plate.SSH for every other index.
      Parameters:
      tab - The selected product-tab index. The value 1 is the Aetheris tab.
      Returns:
      The return value is the plate in front.

    • bar

      public static String[] bar()
      The bar method returns the menu names from west to east. The word west means the left end of the bar. The names are FILE, MENU, and HELP. The string Token Calc is not in the array. The constant Vt100TokenWindow.ITEM is that string.
      Returns:
      The return value is a new array of File, Tools, and Help.

    • show

      public static ToolsThinking.Seat show(boolean open, int slide)
      The show method builds the ToolsThinking.Seat for Show Thinking on one pane. The returned pane is open. The slide stays as given when the pane is already open. The slide is 0 when the pane is closed, which starts the rise. The fold flag is false, so the text is not hidden.
      Parameters:
      open - The pane is already up when the flag is true.
      slide - The current rise count.
      Returns:
      The return value is an open pane, the kept or restarted slide, and a cleared fold.

    • reveal

      public static ToolsThinking.Pair reveal(ToolsThinking.Plate front, ToolsThinking.Seat ssh, ToolsThinking.Seat canvas)
      The reveal method applies Show Thinking to the plate in front. The method calls show(boolean, int) on the Aetheris pane when the front plate is ToolsThinking.Plate.AETHERIS. The SSH pane in that result is the same object that was passed in. The method calls show(boolean, int) on the SSH pane for every other front plate, including a null plate. The Aetheris pane in that result is the same object that was passed in.
      Parameters:
      front - The plate in front.
      ssh - The focused VT100 strip.
      canvas - The Aetheris thinking pane.
      Returns:
      The return value is both panes after the click.
